name: Elasticsearch Helper Content
description: UI + config entity to define Elasticsearch indices for Drupal content entities, with pluggable entity/field normalizers.
project_description:
Elasticsearch Helper Content module provides tools to create Elasticsearch indices for content entities in Drupal UI.

 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 
 Drupal 9 or 10 
 Elasticsearch Helper module 
 Elasticsearch Helper Index Management module 
 
 Back to top 

 Installation 
 Elasticsearch Helper Views module can be installed via the

 standard Drupal installation process .

 
 Install Elasticsearch search engine ( how-to ). 
 Install and enable Elasticsearch Helper module. 
 Install and enable Elasticsearch Helper Index Management module. 
 Install and enable Elasticsearch Helper Content module. 
 
 Back to top 

 Usage 
 
 Go to /admin/config/search/elasticsearch_helper/index 
 Click on the Add content index button. 
 Fill the form with label, index name information, select the entity fields you want to have indexed, and save the form. 
 Click on the Setup button next to the index plugin to create the index in Elasticsearch. 
 Back to top
